performance_case.causal_mechanism: Default stochastic 5-3-3 distinguishes whether a completed-day close is accelerating inside its rolling high-low range relative to a nested simple signal average before the next-open decision.
performance_case.claim_boundary: This task may establish only one pre-2025 historical Design and Validation decision for exact default stochastic 5-3-3 K-D gap thresholds negative 10, zero and positive 10. It cannot inspect post-2024 data, tune any formula or gate, substitute a neighbor, create Trading behavior, activate a strategy or open OOS unless every frozen gate passes.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: The policy is valuable only if it reduces adverse exposure enough to meet strict drawdown and Calmar gates without sacrificing required upside, hiding losses in terminal inventory or concentrating gains in one year or episode.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: The filter may overtrade noisy K-D crossings and miss profitable trends when range position decelerates. One frozen screen either produces a historical candidate for independent OOS or closes the exact family before more oscillator or runtime work consumes capacity.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: The primary SlowK-minus-SlowD above zero state improves after-cost risk-adjusted performance versus matched full-capital buy-and-hold in both Design and historical Validation, with stable negative-10 and positive-10 neighbors and broad annual support.
